title: Artificial intelligence to guide precision anticancer therapy with multitargeted kinase inhibitors.
summary: The study describes CancerOmicsNet deep graph learning over cancer-specific networks and literature-selected unseen predictions; live-cell time-course assays were run in breast, pancreatic and prostate cancer cell lines. The limited result is a set of predicted inhibitor effects with cell-line assays, not patient treatment efficacy.
ai_technology: Attention-based deep graph model predicts effects of multitargeted kinase inhibitors from heterogeneous cancer-network data.
